comment: Sound-name hash directories recovered from audio bank IFFs. Each bank IFF carries 20-byte entries [crc32(name)][0x1AEDDA1F][2][ref][wave_off]; names hash with plain zlib crc32 (Str_Hash @0x84113740 = CRC32 of the wide string's ASCII bytes, no uppercasing). 'name' is the cracked authored name (null = hash not yet cracked). wave_off is relative to the owning container (scene-container banks embed waves; pasfx/paintro/loading_audio pair with a same-stem .cdf wave container). In-container wave codec is NOT the 1A/1B XMA2 packing (undecoded as of 2026-07-18).
